item.title: Violet: an Astro Starlight plugin for planning work with AI agents
item.description:
I’m happy to announce my new personal project: Violet, which is a plugin for Starlight, Astro’s documentation framework. Violet is for the notes that live beside your code: plans, decisions, runbooks, and handoffs. It takes the Markdown files already sitting in your repo and turns them into a documentation site you can actually read. It’s named after “Violet”, a song by Savage Garden.

What it does

item.title: No More Rebuilding the Community Website
item.description:
I’ve been building a website theme.

It’s called Popular, after the song Pop!ular by Darren Hayes. A theme whose whole job is helping small communities put on a good show deserved a name with some sparkle. It’s for meetups and community groups, and 0.11.0 just shipped.

The official announcement, with the feature tour and the demos, is over on the theme’s own site: Introducing Popular. This post is the other half of it. Why it exists at all, what it cost, and who it isn’t for.
